name: Serge Perignon
bio: About the author As the Global Head of TCS Services and the TCS Thought Leadership Institute, Serge Vatin-Perignon has been at the forefront of the global thought leadership movement and technology. With over two decades of experience, he has crafted and executed innovative go-to-marketing strategies that have influenced key business outcomes across large enterprises. At TC...S, Serge has built a leading-edge marketing organization focused on technology services while driving impactful thought leadership initiatives centered on AI and other disruptive technologies. Under his leadership, the company also established a distinguished Thought Leadership R&D center, which has produced numerous global studies, white papers, and articles that have positioned TCS as a thought leader in the industry and in leading publications including Forbes and Harvard Business Review. In addition to strategic excellence, Serge is recognized for building and leading high-performance teams that consistently deliver high-impact results. His ability to blend creativity with data-driven insights has been key to delivering transformative marketing solutions on a global scale. As a testament to his success, Serge is frequently invited to speak at industry conferences, sharing his expertise and vision with audiences worldwide.
